name: Waku Exhibits
description: Waku Exhibits — a landing-page theme for an exhibition stand builder. One long home page opens on a full-bleed documentary photograph of a planner pointing at orange floor tape inside a half-built stand, then a two-line statement whose letters are filled with a hall-floor photograph, four photo rows that touch the viewport edge and alternate right and left under a giant cut word, the planning hour as four counted lines, a parallax hall band, an itemised price table, three stories and a closing band of two flat white cards on a photograph. A thin right rail with a travelling orange dot, a circle menu and drifting halftone dots run through every page. Onest for headings, Hanken Grotesk for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
